title: Spline Curve Editor
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement an interactive spline curve editor that supports dragging control points, TubeGeometry extrusion, curve type switching, and other features. Refer to the official three.js example webgl_geometry_spline_editor, but modify it substantially.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { TransformControls } from 'three/addons/controls/TransformControls.js';
</script>

[Initial Control Points (6)]
Initialize 6 control points with the following coordinates (CatmullRomCurve3):
  P0: (-5, 0, 0)
  P1: (-3, 3, 2)
  P2: (-1, -2, -1)
  P3: (1, 4, 1)
  P4: (3, -1, -2)
  P5: (5, 2, 0)

Visualize each control point with a small sphere (SphereGeometry, radius=0.3, red MeshStandardMaterial).

[Curve and TubeGeometry]
(1) Connect the control points using CatmullRomCurve3 (default) or cubic Bezier curves to generate a smooth curve.
(2) Use TubeGeometry to extrude the curve into a tube mesh with the following parameters: tubularSegments=200, radius controlled by a slider, radialSegments=12, closed=false.
(3) Tube material: MeshStandardMaterial, color #4488ff, metalness=0.3, roughness=0.5.

[TransformControls Dragging]
(4) After clicking a control-point sphere, attach TransformControls to that sphere so it can be dragged and moved.
(5) Update the curve and TubeGeometry in real time while dragging a control point (regenerate the curve and tube geometry whenever a control point moves).
(6) Disable OrbitControls while dragging and restore them after release.

[UI Controls]
(7) id="tubeRadius": range slider with min=0.05, max=1.0, step=0.05, and default value 0.2. Rebuild TubeGeometry in real time when it changes.
(8) id="addPoint": button that, when clicked, inserts a new control point at the midpoint of the current curve (at t=0.5) and automatically updates the curve. New control point position = curve.getPointAt(0.5).
(9) id="removePoint": button that removes the last control point. The number of control points must not fall below 2 (disable the button or have no effect when there are fewer than 2 points).
(10) id="curveType": dropdown or button with values "catmullrom" and "bezier". Regenerate the curve and tube after switching.
  - catmullrom: use CatmullRomCurve3.
  - bezier: interpret the control points as cubic Bezier curves (in groups of 4) and join them using CubicBezierCurve3. If the number of points does not satisfy 3n+1, generate curves only from the leading portion that satisfies the requirement and ignore the remaining points.
(11) id="showPolygon": checkbox controlling whether the control polygon is displayed (a LineLoop polyline connecting all control points). Checked by default.
(12) id="curveLength": read-only display showing the arc length of the current curve (curve.getLength()), rounded to 2 decimal places.
(13) id="exportBtn": button that, when clicked, copies the control-point coordinate array to the clipboard in JSON format: [{x,y,z}, ...].

[Lighting and Scene]
- DirectionalLight (1, 1, 1) positioned at (5, 10, 5).
- AmbientLight with intensity 0.4.
- GridHelper 10x10 ground grid.
- OrbitControls.

[State Exposure (Required, Updated Every Frame)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  pointCount: number,           // Current number of control points
  points: [{x, y, z}, ...],     // Coordinates of each control point (preserve precision to 2 decimal places)
  curveType: string,            // "catmullrom" or "bezier"
  tubeRadius: number,           // Current tube radius
  curveLength: number,          // Curve arc length
  showPolygon: boolean          // Whether the control polygon is displayed
}

Output a single HTML file that can run when opened directly in a browser.
physics_constraints: TubeGeometry extruded along curve, 200 tubular segments
removePoint removes last point, minimum 2 points
curveType toggle: catmullrom vs cubic bezier
curveLength = curve.getLength(), must be positive and finite
